notes: All V values are computed exactly up to final rounding: the counts sum_l Q(x;q,l)^2 are exact integers (FFT autocorrelation of the squarefree indicator; rounding error < 1e-7 << 0.5, checked against bincount), g is (6/pi^2)*exact rational; the combination A - 2x sum gQ + x^2 sum g^2 is done in 50-digit mpmath for q <= 3000 and in float64 for q > 3000 (measured max relative difference to the exact path 3.5e-10 per modulus, see validation).  rows[].V is therefore correct to >= 9 significant digits (V_str: 25 printed digits, meaningful to ~10).  Fitted exponents, the extrapolated constants and their uncertainties are NOT exact. y for a nominal ratio rho is the largest k with f(k) <= rho*x; the normalisation uses the actual f(y). KEY CAVEAT: the normalised value N(x,rho)=V/(x^{1/2} f(y)^{3/2}) is not a smooth function of rho: it oscillates with rho (see diagnostic_scan; local maxima/minima at scales ~0.02-0.1 and a broad hump with maximum near rho~0.85 for 2k+1, for all three f) so a low-order polynomial in rho describes the 8-point grid only roughly and the extrapolation to rho->0 carries a model uncertainty that is not captured by the fit SE (for k^2+1 the sqrt(r)-model gives 0.1346 against 0.1419 for the quadratic; the uncertainty reported includes such variants).  The scan at the smallest ratios actually computed (r=5e-4..0.01) gives mean N = 0.1403 (k^2+1, x=1e8), 0.1421 (k^3+2, x=1e8), 0.1439 (2k+1, x=1e7), i.e. all three constants are ~0.14 and lie within the stated uncertainties of the extrapolations.  At fixed rho, N is stable in x to ~1e-4 relative for 2k+1 and k^2+1 (rho >= 0.05) but for k^3+2 it still drifts down slowly with x (about 0.2-0.4% per doubling of x at rho >= 0.7 at x=1e8) and y-rounding is coarse (only 46..464 moduli).  For small rho the residual N(x,rho)-N(infty,rho) does decay with x (e.g. 2k+1, rho=0.01: 0.1418, 0.1436, 0.1442, 0.1444, 0.1444, 0.1446, 0.1446 for x=1e5..1e7), as the task statement anticipates.  The exponent fits are biased by the rho-dependence of N: at fixed x the slope of ln V against ln f(y) is 3/2 + d ln N/d ln rho, which is slightly above 3/2 over rho in [0.01,1].
